hints.title: Tree Path Extensibility
hints.text: A path with different adjacent characters can pass through a node u as its highest point, joining two downward branches.

hints.title: Subproblem Return Value
hints.text: DFS on node u returns the length of the longest valid path starting at u and descending down into its subtree.

hints.title: Top Two Child Branches
hints.text: For all children v of u whose character differs from that of u, identify the top 2 longest chain lengths to form the longest path centered at u.

hints.title: DFS Tree Path Implementation

variables: n: number of nodes in tree
complexity.notes: Every node and edge is traversed once in bottom-up DFS.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Running a separate traversal from every possible starting node takes O(n^2).
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Call stack and adjacency lists use O(n) space.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate computes longest path centered at each root while returning max single branch length.
